build_retinanet_detector: build a RetinaNet single-stage object detector with backbone, neck, and bbox_head configs
run_retinanet_loss: run the RetinaNet loss computation on a batch of input images and ground truth samples
run_retinanet_predict: run RetinaNet prediction on input images to get bounding boxes, labels, and scores
run_retinanet_extract_feat: run feature extraction through the RetinaNet backbone and neck on input image tensors
review_retinanet_init: review the RetinaNet __init__ to understand how backbone, neck, and bbox_head are wired together
